ageGroups.name: Infant Classroom (0 – 12 Months)
ageGroups.focus: Sensory, Tummy Time, Receptive Language, Fine Pincer & Soothing Melodies

ageGroups.name: Toddler 1 Classroom (1 Year Old / Ones)
ageGroups.focus: Cause & Effect, Vocabulary Spurt, Sensory Fingerpaint & Early Walking Agility

ageGroups.name: 2-Year-Old Classroom (Twos / Early Preschool)
ageGroups.focus: Parallel Play to Cooperative, Color/Shape Sorting, Potty Routines & Expression

ageGroups.name: Preschool 3 y/o Classroom (Threes)
ageGroups.focus: Inquiry Questions, Scissor Skills, Cooperative Building & Social Negotiation

ageGroups.name: Pre-K Classroom (4 – 5 Years Old / GA Lottery Pre-K)
ageGroups.focus: Phonemic Awareness, Mathematical Reasoning, Science Experiments & Self-Regulation
